description: Replace the n512 unsafe-subset Gram/Newton/Rayleigh/recertification chain and remaining grouped-library launches with one persistent Blackwell sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM repair pipeline: consume existing device compaction indices, TMA-stage A/Q tiles, retain Gram/correction state across adaptive iterations, and fuse final values, certificate and scatter. Preserve exact thresholds, BF16x9 quarantine, strict fallback, ranked hardening, concurrency isolation and every other size route; use no WMMA in the native repair path.

First compute_100a/sm_100a persistent eight-CTA n512 repair cluster: direct compact-index consumption, TF32x3 tcgen05/TMEM Gram/Newton/AQ loop, fused Rayleigh certificate and scatter. Build succeeded but official validation faulted on the first n512 case with an illegal memory access reported at the following compaction synchronization.

Masked tcgen05 shared matrix descriptors to the 18-bit CTA-local address so all eight cluster ranks execute correctly. The persistent cluster consumes compact indices directly, runs TF32x3 Gram/Newton/AQ in TMEM, then fuses Rayleigh values, certificate and scatter. Official 39/39 validation passes; full metric is 29111.934 us, with dense/mixed/rankdef n512 at 112138.814/245461.072/296461.857 us. Exact-SHA nsys shows the single native launch costs 62.487 ms on dense n512, versus the parent repair chain at roughly single-digit milliseconds, locating synchronization/TMEM scheduling overhead.

Remapped both native GEMM loaders from logical row-major iteration to consecutive physical K-major shared addresses, removing the profiled 8-way shared-store conflict and grouping global loads into 4x8 subtiles without changing TF32x3 arithmetic. Official 39/39 passes, but full metric regresses from 29111.934 to 31652.544 us; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 regress from 112138.814/245461.072/296461.857 to 150831.721/342673.183/427230.550 us, so source traversal and dependency scheduling dominate the nominal bank-conflict reduction.

Restored the faster logical source traversal and halved accurate K staging from 128 to 64, reducing dynamic shared memory from 128 to 64 KiB and each commit group from 48 to 24 UTCHMMA operations. Official 39/39 passes. Aggregate improves from physical-layout trial 31652.544 to 29407.915 us but remains above the 128-K logical trial at 29111.934; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 are 116081.184/257653.941/310765.457 us versus 112138.814/245461.072/296461.857, so extra commit/wait groups outweigh added residency.

Restored 128-K staging and made early adaptive Newton Gram/application phases single-TF32 while retaining TF32x3 for the final Newton correction, final Gram, AQ, Rayleigh certificate and scatter. Official 39/39 passes with the unchanged strict fallback. Aggregate improves from the all-accurate 29111.934 to 28664.185 us; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 improve from 112138.814/245461.072/296461.857 to 107273.382/229236.745/273453.898 us, measuring useful headroom from adaptive interior precision.

Ran every Newton Gram and correction application in single native TF32 while retaining TF32x3 for the post-update Gram and AQ certificate. Official 39/39 passes; strict flags/fallback remain unchanged. Aggregate improves 28664.185 to 28494.945 us, with dense/mixed/rankdef n512 at 104784.714/226129.682/268168.861 us. Accuracy shifts remain within the official gates, but the incremental speedup shows final accurate Gram/AQ and shared/TMEM scheduling now dominate.

Replaced M64xN64 group-1 GEMMs with four paired M128xN128 tcgen05.mma.cta_group::2 owners inside the persistent eight-CTA cluster, retaining adaptive TF32 and accurate endpoint math. Build succeeded, but the first n512 validation hit cudaErrorIllegalInstruction in the native launch; the new 512-column group-2 TMEM allocation exceeded the proven group-2 encoding surface.

Rebuilt group-2 M128xN128 repair with the proven 128-column TMEM allocation, processing four N tiles sequentially rather than retaining 512 columns. Build succeeded but first n512 validation still raised cudaErrorIllegalInstruction, isolating the unsupported surface to cta_group::2 pairs nested inside an eight-CTA cluster rather than allocation width.

Changed persistent repair ownership to one legal two-CTA group-2 cluster per matrix; the pair sequentially covers four 128-row slabs and device-wide parallelism comes from the candidate grid. Build succeeded, but first n512 validation still hit cudaErrorIllegalInstruction, eliminating cluster dimension as the sole cause and pointing to oversized group-2 MMA commit batches.

Limited group-2 completion batches to two TF32 or six TF32x3 MMAs, preserving the two-CTA persistent owner. Validation still failed; Compute Sanitizer localized the first fault to an invalid remote-shared LDS of the TMEM allocation slot at 0x20400, showing that placing metadata after 128 KiB operand images crosses the group-2 local shared-address boundary.

Moved group-2 TMEM metadata to the low shared prefix, reduced accurate/fast operand images to 96 KiB, zero-filled final K tails, and kept bounded commits. Validation still failed; Compute Sanitizer moved the invalid remote-shared LDS to slot address 0x400 from the follower CTA, proving the group-2 allocation-slot rank bits were incorrectly masked rather than operand storage exceeding capacity.

Restored unmasked group-2 allocation-slot shared addresses so each CTA receives its own TMEM base, while retaining a legal two-CTA cluster, 128-column allocation, bounded commits, low metadata, 96-KiB operand images and compact-index persistence. Official 39/39 passes. Aggregate improves from group-1 adaptive 28494.945 to 27920.097 us; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 improve from 104784.714/226129.682/268168.861 to 93832.225/198623.494/238717.606 us.

Hoisted one 128-column group-2 TMEM allocation and mbarrier across all four row slabs, Newton iterations, final Gram/AQ, certificate and scatter instead of allocating per slab/GEMM. Official 39/39 passes, but aggregate regresses from 27920.097 to 29556.249 us; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 regress from 93832.225/198623.494/238717.606 to 116477.397/257297.595/305025.594 us. Long-lived TMEM ownership reduces concurrent cluster scheduling more than repeated allocation costs.

Restored short-lived per-GEMM TMEM ownership, widened each group-2 allocation to 256 columns, and retained each left 128xK image across two N128 outputs. Official 39/39 passes, but aggregate is 28831.669 us versus 27920.097 for N128 ownership; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 are 103088.361/223096.707/272653.432 us versus 93832.225/198623.494/238717.606. Wider TMEM allocation reduces active pair concurrency more than halved left staging saves.

Restored the N128 group-2 frontier and replaced candidate-count-dependent 3/5/6 native Newton iterations with two for every compact candidate; TF32x3 final Gram/AQ certificate, second repair and strict library fallback remain unchanged. Official 39/39 passes. Aggregate improves 27920.097 to 26862.535 us; dense/mixed/rankdef n512 improve from 93832.225/198623.494/238717.606 to 88540.970/152368.003/205957.468 us, showing extra native iterations were costly and often redundant.
Reduce native cluster repair from two Newton iterations to one; valid but increases dense and rank-deficient fallback cost.
Retain one cta_group::2 N128 TMEM allocation across the four row slabs of each GEMM, releasing between GEMMs/SIMT phases; 39/39 valid and performance neutral.
Increase group2 fast/accurate K chunks from 96/48 to 128/64 with 128 KiB shared staging after fixing allocation addressing; legal and 39/39 valid, but residency regresses n512 throughput.

Issue only high-high plus high-right-low endpoint products and reduce shared staging from four buffers to three (72 KiB); n512 validation hits illegal memory access, likely due changed cluster residency/scheduling.
Keep proven 96 KiB group2 cluster geometry but reduce accurate endpoint products from HH+HL+LH to HH+HL; 39/39 valid and improves dense n512 while preserving certificates/fallbacks.
Use complementary HH+LH two-term endpoint correction at identical tcgen05 cost; 39/39 valid, but mixed/rankdef fallback expansion regresses versus HH+HL.
Split endpoint precision: HH+HL for Gram, full HH+HL+LH for A*Q; 39/39 valid, but extra AQ correction cost is not recovered by lower fallback.
Split endpoint precision: full HH+HL+LH for Q^TQ Gram, HH+HL for A*Q; 39/39 valid and new best, with rankdef fallback reduced enough to repay the extra Gram term.
Keep full three-term Q^TQ Gram but use one-term TF32 A*Q with larger fast K chunks; unchanged eigen certificate catches unsafe cases, 39/39 valid and new best.
Use HH+HL two-term Q^TQ Gram and one-term TF32 A*Q; certificates/fallbacks unchanged, 39/39 valid, lower native cost outweighs rankdef fallback increase for new best.
Use one-term TF32 for both final Gram and A*Q; 39/39 valid through unchanged certificates/fallbacks, but mixed/rankdef fallback expansion regresses sharply.

Follow official SM100 cta_group::2 partitioning: each CTA stages compact 64-row M/N halves with 64-row K-major descriptors instead of 128-row images plus zeros; preserves 96 KiB reservation, 39/39 valid, material new best.
Reduce compact group2 dynamic shared reservation from 96 to 80 KiB while preserving two-CTA-per-SM residency; 39/39 valid and n512 performance neutral within noise.
Reduce compact group2 reservation to 64 KiB, enabling three resident CTAs per SM after correcting local 64-row descriptors; 39/39 valid and large new best across native n512 routes.
Reserve exact 48 KiB compact operand footprint to enable four resident CTAs per SM; 39/39 valid, dense improves slightly but mixed/rankdef slow enough to make three-CTA 64 KiB point better.
With compact 64-row CTA-pair images, widen fast K chunks 96->128 and reserve 64 KiB+metadata, retaining three-CTA residency while cutting Newton/AQ phases; 39/39 valid, large new best.
Widen compact accurate Gram K chunks 48->64 at unchanged 64 KiB reservation and three-CTA residency; 39/39 valid but slightly slower across n512 routes.
Batch tcgen05 group2 MMAs across 32 K values per commit/wait instead of 16, preserving arithmetic, descriptors, certificates and three-CTA residency; 39/39 valid, small new best.

Batch tcgen05 group2 MMAs across 64 K values per commit/wait; accurate Gram becomes one bounded 12-MMA batch and fast paths use two 8-MMA batches, with unchanged math/certificates; 39/39 and new best.
Batch each 128-wide fast K tile into one bounded 16-MMA tcgen05 commit/wait; accurate 48-wide Gram remains one 12-MMA batch. Math/certificates unchanged, 39/39 valid, small new best.

Widen accurate endpoint K tile 48->80 without compacting the correction-image layout; build succeeds but validation catches illegal shared-memory access because the unused left-low allocation pushes the footprint past 64 KiB.

Compact production HH+HL accurate staging by omitting its disabled left-low image, then widen accurate K tiles 48->80 within 60 KiB and unchanged three-CTA residency; 39/39 valid and new best across native n512 routes.

Replace native group2 scalar staging with CUDA 13 TFLOAT32 TMA into CUTLASS-compatible SM100 128B-MN/32B-K swizzled atoms and matched tcgen05 descriptors; 39/39 valid, but serial small-atom issue/wait overhead regresses n512 substantially.

Apply CuTe composed-layout element-offset swizzle to the accurate residual image; 39/39 valid but solver fallback remains dominant. A direct hardware TMA probe then shows the engine permutes byte-address cells instead, so this convention is not the physical residual layout.

Use raw FLOAT32 TMA copies, then restore exact cvt.rna.tf32 staging in shared memory and fuse HH+HL residual formation without a global reread; 39/39 valid, but fallback population persists and conversion pass adds cost.

Diagnostic bypass of all post-native n512 repair shows the raw TMA/tcgen result has orthogonality residual exactly 1 on every routed matrix, confirming a genuine native GEMM failure rather than an over-conservative certificate.
Hybrid Blackwell TMA Gram staging with proven manual K-major update path; 39/39 serial evaluator cases pass and isolates full-TMA collapse to mixed-major update staging
Use Blackwell SW32 TMA for non-transpose A while preserving proven K-major B and tcgen05 instruction major; 39/39 pass and improves hybrid by 221.4

Stopped on coherent c83afadbee4dc99a92c1030197aa44e36df3e2db: Blackwell tcgen05/TMEM plus TMA Gram and SW32 A-only update, 39/39 pass, metric 26782.169338, exact native kernel 19.340 ms. Branch best remains trial36 6e5b9a88 metric 25919.322095 (native 24.019 ms). Full TMA reached 11.757 ms native but collapsed outputs from the mixed-major/B path and triggered fallback. Remaining work is correct B-side TMA/mixed-major semantics and, given the legitimate ~8.664 ms leader, a broader algorithmic redesign rather than incremental staging.
